correctness.rationale: Products of degree-3 spherical harmonics have only degrees 0,2,4,6. The icosahedron is a spherical 5-design, suppressing degree 2,4 center sums, so cap averaging gives G_c=I+a6(c)(G_pt-I). The six antipodal representatives yield the exact Seidel/conference S^2=5I and G_pt spectrum {0×4,7/3×3}, using 7P3 reproducing kernel. Funk–Hecke integration gives a6(c)=c(1+c)(429c^4-390c²+65)/208; the two positive nontrivial roots are c±=sqrt((195±26sqrt15)/429). Signs yield 4/3/4 least sectors; strict positivity from real analyticity over open caps; P6 prime at 1=21 implies A~(21/2)(1-c) and kappa~2/[9(1-c)]. Independently rederived polynomial integral/symbolic roots and conference identity; numerical 7-cap checks inspected in packaged script, not used for all c proof.
